title: Component along incline
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the component of the pulling force along the incline as F cos β.

title: Normal force magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the magnitude of the normal force as G cos α - F sin β.

title: Frictional force magnitude
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the magnitude of the frictional force as F cos β - G sin α.

title: Force equilibrium reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law (equilibrium) for constant velocity, resolving forces parallel and perpendicular to the incline.

title: Correct force decomposition
description: Important: The solution must correctly decompose the applied force F into components parallel (F cos β) and perpendicular (F sin β) to the incline.

title: Weight component identification
description: Important: The solution must correctly decompose the weight G into components parallel (G sin α) and perpendicular (G cos α) to the incline.

title: Friction direction consistency
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify that friction acts down the incline, opposing the upward motion.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: A common error is to incorrectly add F sin β in the normal force equation, writing G cos α + F sin β.

title: Sign error in friction force
description: Pitfall: A common error is to incorrectly add the weight component, writing F cos β + G sin α, or reverse the subtraction order.

title: Unit inclusion or clarity
description: Optional: The final answers explicitly include units (N) or clearly state the quantities are forces.
